scope: Bounded local Sheets behavior benchmark. Not full Google Sheets parity.

cases.behavior: named ranges calculate aggregates and reject unknown names
cases.testName: [S2-01] named ranges calculate aggregates and reject unknown names

cases.behavior: DATE normalizes month overflow and YEAR MONTH DAY preserve leap day
cases.testName: [S2-02] DATE normalizes month overflow and YEAR MONTH DAY preserve leap day

cases.behavior: EDATE clamps a month-end date and EOMONTH returns leap month end
cases.expectedResult: EDATE and EOMONTH both return serial 45351 (2024-02-29)
cases.testName: [S2-03] EDATE clamps a month-end date and EOMONTH returns leap month end

cases.behavior: DATEDIF counts complete months and rejects backwards intervals
cases.testName: [S2-04] DATEDIF counts complete months and rejects backwards intervals

cases.behavior: SUMIFS and COUNTIFS combine multiple criteria
cases.testName: [S2-05] SUMIFS and COUNTIFS combine multiple criteria

cases.behavior: XLOOKUP supports exact, nearest-smaller, reverse search and missing result
cases.testName: [S2-06] XLOOKUP supports exact, nearest-smaller, reverse search and missing result

cases.behavior: HLOOKUP supports exact horizontal search and rejects bad modes
cases.testName: [S2-07] HLOOKUP supports exact horizontal search and rejects bad modes

cases.behavior: TEXT formats dates and currency; REPLACE uses one-based offsets
cases.testName: [S2-08] TEXT formats dates and currency; REPLACE uses one-based offsets

cases.behavior: SPLIT returns a two-dimensional row with delimiter options
cases.testName: [S2-09] SPLIT returns a two-dimensional row with delimiter options

cases.behavior: SEQUENCE spills values into the real grid and downstream ranges calculate
cases.testName: [S2-10] SEQUENCE spills values into the real grid and downstream ranges calculate

cases.behavior: blocked array spills report REF without overwriting occupied cells
cases.expectedResult: #REF! at blocked anchor; occupied Keep survives; no partial spill
cases.testName: [S2-11] blocked array spills report REF without overwriting occupied cells

cases.behavior: TRANSPOSE and UNIQUE return actual array values
cases.testName: [S2-12] TRANSPOSE and UNIQUE return actual array values

cases.behavior: merge and unmerge preserve hidden underlying cell contents
cases.expectedResult: Merge metadata=A1:B1; B1 remains100; unmerge restores; overlap rejects
cases.testName: [S2-13] merge and unmerge preserve hidden underlying cell contents

cases.behavior: fill series infers numeric step and shifts relative formula references
cases.testName: [S2-14] fill series infers numeric step and shifts relative formula references

cases.behavior: fill series increments text suffixes and respects strict validation
cases.expectedResult: Task7 extends toTask9; strict dropdown rejects fill
cases.testName: [S2-15] fill series increments text suffixes and respects strict validation

cases.behavior: protected ranges and sheets block fill without modifying source
cases.expectedResult: Protected A2 true/B2 false; fill rejects without mutation; whole-sheet protection applies
cases.testName: [S2-16] protected ranges and sheets block fill without modifying source

cases.behavior: XLSX standard OOXML contains merges named ranges validation and conditional formatting
cases.expectedResult: Native OOXML merges/definedName/list validation/cfRule; reimport SUM(Revenue)=600
cases.testName: [S2-17] XLSX standard OOXML contains merges named ranges validation and conditional formatting

cases.behavior: XLSX preserves borders wrap font sizing hidden rows freeze and local chart metadata
cases.expectedResult: Font18, wrap, bottom border #112233, hidden rows/cols, height60, frozenCol1 and pie chart survive
cases.testName: [S2-18] XLSX preserves borders wrap font sizing hidden rows freeze and local chart metadata

cases.behavior: Pivot groups multiple fields and splits columns
cases.testName: [S2-19] pivot groups multiple fields and splits columns with correct totals
